{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are generally 0.1-0.3 too high compared to true outcomes, indicating systematic overshoot of volatility",
    "Sentiment positively correlates with price movements but model forecasts underweight sentiment shifts, especially at inflection points",
    "When price has been flat for 3+ days, model misses the magnitude of the next move by ~10-15%",
    "Sentiment turning from negative to positive predicts 0.2-0.4 price increase that model forecasts as ~0.1",
    "Model mean-reverts too aggressively - when price deviates 1+ standard deviation from trend, model under-predicts the continuation by ~5-8%",
    "Sentiment consolidation (all values 0.5-0.67) causes model to miss 0.1-0.2 daily drift that sentiment momentum creates",
    "When sentiment moves from extreme (1.0) to moderate (0.67), model delays the price response by 1-2 forecast steps"
] }
